topic: Parler de ce qui se Passe dans les Professions (Talking About What Happens in Professions)

subUnits.title: 3.1 Les Métiers et Leur Fonction
notes: Les Métiers et Leur Fonction
By the end of this lesson, you will be able to: describe the function or role of different professions in society.
Key Concepts:
1. Connecting Professions to Their Characteristic Actions:
- l'infirmier(ère) SOIGNE les malades à l'hôpital (the nurse cares for the sick at the hospital)
- le médecin EXAMINE les patients (the doctor examines patients)
- le mécanicien RÉPARE les voitures (the mechanic repairs cars)
- le pilote CONDUIT l'avion (the pilot flies/drives the plane)
- le journaliste ÉCRIT des articles (the journalist writes articles)
2. Key New Verb — Soigner (a regular -ER verb):
- SOIGNER (to care for/treat) follows the SAME familiar pattern as aimer and détester.
- RÉPARER (to repair) also follows this pattern.
- Note: ÉCRIRE (to write) is irregular — take care with its conjugation.
Formula Box:
[profession] + [verb] + [object]: le médecin examine les patients
soigner: je soigne | tu soignes | il/elle soigne | nous soignons | vous soignez | ils/elles soignent
Analogy:

Connecting a profession to its characteristic action is like matching an actor to their signature role: knowing an actor's NAME alone tells you little, but knowing the SPECIFIC role they are famous for playing brings them vividly to life — similarly, knowing 'l'infirmier(ère)' as a word is useful, but knowing 'l'infirmier(ère) SOIGNE LES MALADES' brings the profession genuinely to life.
Common Mistakes to Avoid:
- Learning profession vocabulary in isolation, without connecting each profession to its CHARACTERISTIC action.
- Forgetting to conjugate the new '-ER' verb (soigner, réparer) correctly for the subject being described.

quiz.explanation: 'Soigner' means 'to care for' or 'to treat' (as in treating sick people at a hospital).

quiz.q: Who 'soigne les malades à l'hôpital' (cares for the sick at the hospital)?
quiz.explanation: 'L'infirmier(ère) soigne les malades à l'hôpital' — the nurse cares for sick people at the hospital.
'Le médecin examine les patients' — the doctor examines patients.
'Le mécanicien répare les voitures' — the mechanic repairs cars.
'Le journaliste écrit des articles' — the journalist writes articles.
'Le pilote conduit l'avion' — the pilot flies/drives the plane.

opts: A verb with no fixed pattern
quiz.explanation: 'Soigner' is a regular -ER verb and conjugates exactly like aimer and détester.

quiz.q: How would you say 'the nurse cares for the sick at the hospital'?
opts: L'infirmier(ère) soigne les malades à l'hôpital
L'infirmier(ère) a soigné les malades hôpital
L'infirmier(ère) est les malades à l'hôpital
L'infirmier(ère) soigne les malades au hôpital
quiz.explanation: The correct sentence uses 'soigne' (conjugated for il/elle) and 'à l'hôpital' (not 'au hôpital' — 'hôpital' starts with a vowel sound, so 'à l'' is used).

quiz.q: Connecting a profession to its action is compared to ___ in this week's analogy.
opts: a connection with no real educational value
knowing only an actor's name, with nothing further
matching an actor to their signature role
quiz.explanation: Knowing a profession's characteristic action brings it to life, just as knowing an actor's famous role brings them to life beyond just their name.

quiz.q: Learning profession-plus-function sentences moves beyond simple vocabulary toward ___.
opts: real, functional knowledge of the working world
quiz.explanation: Connecting professions to their functions builds genuinely useful, real-world knowledge of how the working world operates.

weeklyAssessment.question: Traduisez: 'to care for/treat,' 'to repair,' 'to examine,' 'to write.'
weeklyAssessment.markingGuide: 1.25 marks per correctly translated verb (4 items, 5 total).

weeklyAssessment.question: Associez chaque profession à sa fonction correcte: l'infirmier(ère), le médecin, le mécanicien, le journaliste.
weeklyAssessment.markingGuide: 1.25 marks per correctly matched profession-function pair (4 pairs, 5 total).

weeklyAssessment.question: Traduisez: 'The nurse cares for the sick. The doctor examines patients.'
weeklyAssessment.markingGuide: 2.5 marks each for a correctly translated, correctly structured sentence.

weeklyAssessment.question: Rédigez UNE phrase décrivant la fonction de CHACUNE des professions suivantes: le pilote, l'avocat(e).
weeklyAssessment.markingGuide: 2.5 marks each for a correctly formed, meaningful sentence.

weeklyAssessment.question: Rédaction: écrivez une courte rédaction (au moins 3 phrases) sur la profession que vous aimez le plus, en incluant sa fonction.
weeklyAssessment.markingGuide: Three grammatically correct sentences describing a profession and its function (5, holistic).
